title: The workspace chat's tables through /mcp; the long agents as operations
request: The owner (2026-10-25): DCLab Code, a minimal developer app like Claude Code and Codex, must carry every capability of the R&D project behind its chat: "all agentic systems we designed work behind the chat, as Claude's or Codex's do"; then "most things are available: implement, adopt and integrate them, no need to make them again"; "the main repo" is this R&D repository (Research_Development_DCLab), not the main product repository.
plan: find which R&D agents a chat still cannot reach
pass through what no route serves
guard the long agents on the host

decisions.decision: Of every agent in agents.harness.AGENTS and every registry scope, only the workspace chat (30.21) had no route; its three read tools pass through /mcp as they are, with a fresh Session a call (an MCP chat has no question boundary, so the shown-values budget holds per call).
decisions.why: a chat should reach every agent; only this one had no route

decisions.decision: The Home agent's and orchestrator's own tools (scopes draft and home) stay theirs: a chat drives those agents with home_message, never their tools directly.
decisions.why: those tools are the agents' own; driving them directly would duplicate the orchestrator

decisions.decision: The intern, the teams and the twin are reached through dclab_call; DCLab Code asks the person before POST .../team and the intern's sessions, which can read the holdout.
decisions.why: the intern and the teams can run the final stage, which reads the holdout once

change: mcp_server lists and dispatches the registry's workspace scope; DCLab Code's guard and prompt.

measurements.name: workspace tables test
measurements.gate: a project's table listed, described and counted over MCP; a private project's never listed

outcome: Partly done: the workspace's tables are reachable from a chat, masked; the long agents are reachable through the bridge; an intern job's finish and a team walk's pause over MCP are not tested yet.
lessons: Map every agent and scope before building: most were already reachable.
risks: the shown-values budget is per call over MCP, weaker than the workspace chat's per question
the workspace chat's grounding check (every number from a computation) does not apply to an external model's answer
